note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 41K-like reel presents 'the perfect christmas party dress' — a magenta floral lace long-sleeve mini dress with a high neck, fitted silhouette, scalloped hem, and matching fabric belt, worn over a nude slip dress and finished with gold hoop earrings with red stones, pink lipstick, a cream pearl-trimmed clutch, and dark pointed-toe heels. An 18K-like 'Fall/Winter outfit inspo' lookbook layers a black mini skirt, an oversized gray turtleneck sweater, black sheer tights, and black knee-high boots, finished with a taupe wrap coat and a large black tote bag. An 11K-like clip models a dramatic strapless black-and-white feather dress with an asymmetrical hem, a high thigh slit, and a completely backless cut, worn with nude pointed heels and a small black clutch. A 9K-like 'SHEIN Vs Reality - Festive season' try-on runs six holiday outfits against a white wall, alternating the official product photo with the real fit — a multicolor geometric sequin mini dress; a black one-shoulder jumpsuit with a belt; a red sequin long-sleeve skater dress; a black maxi dress with a pink satin off-the-shoulder top; a gold sequin midi skirt with a black crop top; and a black textured off-the-shoulder mini dress with a large back bow. An 8K-like 'winter outfit inspo' try-on cycles through six looks to a cover of 'Last Christmas' — a Santa hat with a red fitted crop top and low-rise beige cargo pants; an oversized gray knit sweater dress over black shorts; a tan overshirt over a light blue tee; a brown suede top with black trousers and a brown cap; a white cardigan with blue jeans and tan boots; and a long beige trench coat over a white button top and black pants. An 8K-like try-on captioned 'Sequins but cozy' pairs sequined midi skirts with comfortable knits — a champagne sequin skirt with a black short-sleeve top; a dark bronze sequin skirt with a cream turtleneck and white heels; a black sequin skirt with a black fuzzy sweater; the champagne skirt with a white V-neck sweater; and the bronze skirt with a gray sweatshirt. A 7K-like 'BUY OR BYEEE?' haul, modeled in a size 14, runs four looks — a long bronze sequin midi skirt with a side slit and black turtleneck; a short black sequin mini-skirt with a brown bodysuit layered under a zebra-print coat; a sleeveless bronze sequin shift dress with black tights, heels, and a black blazer; and gold satin wide-leg pants with a matching bronze sequin top. A 6K-like 'trust the process' transformation builds an all-black ensemble — a black sheer sequined maxi skirt layered over a black long-sleeve top with a sheer mesh neckline, sheer black stockings, black pointed-toe heels, and a small black clutch.
trends.title: Magenta lace, sequins-but-cozy knits, and feather dresses — party try-ons keep rolling

trends.details: A 36K-like reel builds a greenery trellis on the curved white wall of a grand foyer beneath a sweeping staircase and crystal chandelier — a diamond lattice mapped out in thin wire, fresh cedar branches cut to size and tied along the lines with green velvet ribbons, candles lit in two arched wall niches. A 25K-like DIY makes a woven Christmas stocking from scratch — strips of burgundy, green, and patterned velvet ribbon basketwoven together, stabilized with fusible interfacing, sewn on a Singer machine, finished with a velvet hanging loop. A 24K-like 'Holiday Decorating At The Estate' unloads bundles of fresh evergreen garland from an SUV and drapes them along a balcony railing and down a grand staircase, decorates a large tree with lights, wide red velvet ribbons, and dried hydrangeas, and builds a lush dried-hydrangea and magnolia arrangement across an ornate white fireplace mantel. A 24K-like carousel documents a family setting up a very large artificial Christmas tree at night, a giant red velvet bow already attached, the woman standing on a window ledge with a long red pole to place decorations high up, ending in a towering fully lit tree reaching nearly to the ceiling. A 19K-like cinematic walkthrough, posted today and captioned 'If Christmas were a feeling,' drifts from two golden retrievers at the front door past a staircase wrapped in greenery and red velvet ribbons, multiple lit trees in wicker baskets, and a living room with a lit fireplace, stockings, and another decorated tree. A 13K-like reel puts up a tree in a brown-and-gold palette — large shiny champagne and silver baubles, clusters of matte chocolate-brown velvet baubles on gold wire, and dark reddish-brown glittery fern stems as a topper. A 10K-like 'Decorate My English Country Home With Me' dresses a 9-foot tree from the top down with tartan ribbon, pheasant feathers, and antique silver-hued baubles, then builds an overhead greenery garland above the kitchen cabinets and sets the dining table with sprigs of greenery in bud vases, woven placemats, blue-and-white Spode plates, and plaid napkins. A 9K-like 'decorate my garland with me' reel styles a front-door garland arch — a frosted wreath with a red velvet bow, large velvet baubles in burgundy and emerald green, gold bells tied with red ribbon, and a decorative wooden sleigh with greenery at the base.
trends.title: Greenery trellises, woven stockings, and whole-house Christmas — decorating hits full swing

trends.details: An 88K-like carousel features Victoria Beckham demonstrating her 'Signature Sculpt' winter makeup routine in front of a lit fireplace — Contour Stylus in Marble blended with the 12 Buffer Brush, Colour Wash Blush Water Tint in Flushed for a winter flush, Reflect Highlighter Stick in Pearl on cheekbones, brow bone, and lips, then a gifting segment with Hotel Portofino Extrait de Parfum and new burgundy-and-white gift wrap. A 21K-like 'Christmas makeup' tutorial, worn with a white faux-fur hat and cream knit sweater, applies shimmery light eyeshadow, bright pink cream blush, and Maybelline 'Daylight Cream Highlighter' on eyelids, cheekbones, nose, and lips for a dewy glow. A 16K-like 'Festive Stars' tutorial cuts star shapes from tape, places them on the cheeks, colors over them with red lipstick as cream pigment, blends black eyeshadow around them, then peels the stencils off to reveal clean stars, finished with red and black rhinestones and mascara. A 13K-like 'Winter makeup tuto' applies makeup step by step in a handheld mirror — eyeshadow from a round palette, eyeliner, lip liner, lip gloss, and an eyelash curler. An 8K-like tutorial makes a 'worst' red lipstick work for her complexion — L'Oreal Paris Colour Riche Matte Lipstick lined with NYX Stain Loud in deep red, yellow-toned color corrector around the mouth, Makeup Forever Balancing Foundation, Hung Vanngo Transculpt Bronzer, and a warm bronze eye from the ABH Spice Mini palette. An 8K-like full-face glam, lit in red ambient light and set to 'Santa Tell Me,' runs liquid foundation and concealer, pink eyeshadow, a sharp winged liner, mascara, contour, and a dark matte lipstick. A 6K-like extreme close-up builds a mauve eye — Morphe 'WINE' liner along the lash line, shimmery dusty-rose shadow blended into the crease, and a lighter matte shade above it for a soft metallic mauve smoky eye. A 5K-like 'winter frosty glam' tutorial, posed in a white fluffy fur coat, layers an icy shade on the lid and brow bone, cool brown in the crease, shimmery silver pigment, black liner and mascara, soft pink blush, and glossy nude-pink lips, naming Huda Beauty, Natasha Denona, Marc Jacobs, Kylie Cosmetics, and Charlotte Tilbury products.
trends.title: Victoria Beckham's sculpted winter glow, festive stars, and frosty glam
